objective.value: Assess and quantify the effectiveness of inert-gas suppressants in microgravity and obtain the most conservative estimate of the limiting oxygen index (LOI) for steady combustion; map the flammability boundaries of liquid-fuel droplets in reduced gravity and validate chemical-kinetic and transport models.

sources.note: FLEX overview: designed to assess/quantify effectiveness of inert-gas suppressants and estimate the LOI; maps flammability boundaries for liquid fuel combustion in reduced gravity
MDCA-FLEX summary: assess fire-suppressant effectiveness in microgravity and quantify effects of possible crew exploration atmospheres on fire suppression
Challenge brief, 'Background': 'Suppression was studied in the Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) through dilution of the chamber atmosphere with carbon dioxide and helium'
FLEX overview: near-limit diffusion-flame study developing and validating detailed kinetic/transport models (fundamental combustion science)

safety_functions.note: Brief classifies FLEX under suppression; the overview frames it as fundamental near-limit droplet-combustion research that also informs suppression.
